text:
alex: quick sync 1 PR #3401 proposes renaming sdk methods and param keys across ts/python snippets. main user-facing change: `client.create(...)` -> `client.send(...)`, and payload key `modelId` -> `model`. need minimal migration note and voice check before we merge.
jo: can we see a short in-doc example of old->new? that helps support and customers.
alex: yes — planning a 3-line diff in the migration guide and a callout in quickstart. rachel, any tone preferences?
rachel: keep docs imperative and actionable. i prefer phrasing like "Call client.send(...)" rather than "Use the send method". it's concise and maps to snippets.
pete: small caveat: in CLI guides we currently use "create" as a user-facing verb in sentences: "create a completion". should we normalize docs prose to "generate" instead of forcing SDK verb everywhere?
morgan: +1 to using "generate" in prose where we describe user intent, and "send" when referring to SDK code. separate concept: intent vs API verb. that reduces confusion.
jo: agree. examples: prose: "Generate text for a prompt." code: "await client.send({ model: '...' })".
doclint-bot: style-check: finds instances of "create a completion" in 4 files and flagged inconsistent casing for product names (dedicated vs Dedicated).
rachel: let's add a glossary line for product names and deployment modes to enforce capitalization. pete, can you draft a one-line policy?
pete: draft: "Product names are capitalized (Redwood Dedicated, Redwood Private). Deployment modes (dedicated, private) when used generically should be lowercase." ok?
morgan: LGTM. also propose: add glossary entry: "send (SDK) - canonical method name for making generation requests; use `send` in code and `generate` in prose".
alex: action items: pete to draft product-name capitalization, morgan to add glossary entries, jo to add migration snippet, rachel to sweep tone. I will run a small codemod for snippets after alignment.
jo: codemod note: I'll change `modelId:` -> `model:` and `create\s*\(` variants. I'll output changed file list in PR comment.
doclint-bot: link-check: the PR currently has 2 new internal links that point to /guides/migrate-create -> 404. please add redirect or update to /guides/migration-sdk-methods.
alex: add redirect if possible; otherwise update links. who can change the routing?
morgan: infra team owns redirects, but we can add the migration doc first and update the link. better not to block merge for redirect.
rachel: migration snippet done, here's the copy (paste): "Old: await client.create({ modelId: 'r-instruct', prompt: '...' })
New: await client.send({ model: 'r-instruct', input: '...' })". includes note: "Field `prompt` renamed to `input` in SDK v2."
jo: good. I'll include that in the PR description as 2 bullets and a code block.
pete: quick check: examples in Python need the same change; also make sure test harnesses still pass. I'll run the docs build locally after codemod.
morgan: glossary additions pushed to /docs/glossary.md and link in quickstart.
doclint-bot: style-check: all flagged "create a completion" occurrences replaced. link-check: /guides/migration-sdk-methods exists now.
alex: timeline? can we merge today if tests and link-check pass?
rachel: yes, i can do a final tone sweep in 30m.
jo: codemod finished: changed 9 files. listed in PR comment. ran doc build, minor lint warnings fixed.
alex: excellent. i'll wait for rachel and then request merge. please leave any microcopy suggestions as inline comments. thanks everyone.
